title: Food production
description: Ozonation at food facilities ensures product safety, extends shelf life and meets HACCP requirements. An eco-friendly alternative to chemical preservatives.

cheese.title: Cheese production
cheese.shortDesc: Ripening and storage of cheese without mold
cheese.content:
In cheese production, ozonation addresses the key issue of preventing unwanted mold on cheese surfaces during ripening and storage. The technology controls chamber microflora without affecting the ripening process.

For hard cheeses, 2–4 mg/m³ ozone is recommended; for soft cheeses, 3–6 mg/m³ at 8–12°C and 85–90% humidity. Treatment for 1.5–2 hours gives 94–99% disinfection efficiency.

Ozone prevents mold on the rind without disrupting ripening biochemistry. At correct dosage it does not affect color, consistency or taste. Ozonation has been recommended for hard cheese storage in industry guidelines.

intro.paragraph1: In cheese production, ozonation addresses the key issue of preventing unwanted mold on cheese surfaces during ripening and storage. The technology controls chamber microflora without affecting the biochemical ripening processes.
intro.paragraph2: Ozone prevents mold development on the cheese rind without disrupting the balance of beneficial microflora inside the cheese head. At correct dosage, ozone does not affect the color, consistency, taste, or aroma of the finished product.

instruction.label: Temporary instruction of the RSFSR Ministry of Trade, 1975:
instruction.text: Ozonation is recommended for storing hard rennet cheeses. The method allows controlling mold on the cheese surface without using chemical preservatives.

regimes.title: Ozonation regimes for different cheese types
regimes.tableCaption: Recommended treatment regimes for cheese ripening chambers
regimes.warningText: For cheeses like Camembert, Brie, and Roquefort, a gentle ozonation regime (1-2 mg/m³, 30 minutes) is required to control unwanted mold without damaging the cultured mold.

benefits.title: Benefits of ozonation in cheese production
items: Prevention of unwanted mold development on the cheese rind
Preservation of the ripening process — ozone does not penetrate inside the cheese head
Reduced product shrinkage due to microflora stabilization
Treatment without unloading cheese from the ripening chamber
Compliance with GOST R 54607-2011 "Cheeses. General technical specifications"
Automation of disinfection process on a scheduled basis

impact.title: Effect of ozone on the product
impact.paragraph: Research shows that ozone suppresses microflora growth on cheese surfaces while preserving their organoleptic properties — taste, aroma, texture, and color. The bactericidal effect is particularly pronounced under conditions of high humidity (70-90%) and moderate temperatures (+8...+14°C), typical of ripening chambers.

comparison.title: Comparison of mold control methods for cheeses

chamberTreatment.title: Ripening chamber treatment
chamberTreatment.paragraph: For stationary ripening chambers, wall-mounted or ducted ozonators with automatic control are recommended. Ozone is distributed evenly throughout the chamber volume, penetrating hard-to-reach areas including racks and shelves.
chamberTreatment.tableCaption: Example treatment regime for cheese ripening chamber (50 m³ volume)
chamberTreatment.successText: Regular ozonation of ripening chambers (1-2 times per day for 1.5-2 hours) allows eliminating manual cheese wiping and reducing chamber maintenance labor costs by 70-80%.
